events.text: There is no one left who can teach you anything. There is no one left who can even watch you train and understand what they see.

choices.text: Teach yourself, as the first masters did

effects.log: You write questions on the cliff face and answer them over a century. The cliff becomes a place of pilgrimage.
You come down the mountain and teach anyone who asks. The murim of the next hundred years is shaped by you.

events.text: Three dynasties have risen and fallen since you were born. Each emperor sent envoys to your mountain. You have lost count of the gifts.

effects.log: He is very young and very frightened of you. You tell him to rule kindly. He does, mostly.
The court decides you must be a myth. That suits you.

events.text: A crowd at your gate: hundreds of people who are all, somehow, your descendants. They want to meet the ancestor.

effects.log: It takes a year. You remember every name. A whole province carries a little of your blood, and your kindness.
One blessing, a thousand bowed heads. They go home with a story to tell their grandchildren.

events.text: In a moment of carelessness, your energy moves a mountain a finger's width. The villages below feel it.

effects.log: Power that cannot be held is not power. Your energy settles, deeper than before.
You rebuild every wall that cracked, by hand. The villagers name a festival after it.

events.text: The sky splits over your mountain: not lightning this time, but something that looks back at you.

ok.log: You meet it, and it looks away first. Your body is lighter, your years longer, and every master on earth felt it.

fail.deathCause: heaven's gaze, which you met and could not hold
fail.log: You hold for a day and a night before it presses you into the stone. You live. Heaven is patient.

effects.log: The sky closes. You are not ready, and you know it. That, too, is wisdom.

events.text: A child walks up your mountain with your oldest rival's eyes and your oldest rival's terrible manners.

choices.text: Take the child as your last disciple

effects.log: Some rivalries are too good to end. This time, you teach them everything.
The child loses, laughs exactly the way your rival used to, and leaves. You are sure you will meet again.

events.text: You come out of seclusion to find the language has changed. People speak your old words with new meanings.

effects.log: A decade of being a student again. It is the most fun you have had in a century.
The world will always be changing. The mountain will not.

variants: You come out of a century of seclusion and the town below speaks a different tongue: your old words are still in it, but they mean new things, and people smile when you use them.

events.text: Temples to you stand in a dozen cities. Some of them ask you for rain. Some of them ask you for revenge.

effects.log: Three dry provinces get their harvest. You do not answer the others.
Most of them do. The ones that stay open become kinder places.

events.text: In the deepest seclusion, you see it: the last gate, Divine Transcendence. It is not far. It was never far.

effects.log: Every step costs a century and teaches you more than the last thousand years.
There are still people you love in the world below. The gate will wait.

events.text: A plague no physician can cure sweeps the empire. Only one being in the world could stop it.

choices.text: Pour your energy into the land

ok.log: For a season, every well in the empire tastes faintly of you. The plague breaks. History books will not believe it.

fail.log: It takes nearly everything you have. The plague breaks; you sleep for ten years.
fail.deathCause: a burden too heavy even for you

choices.text: Teach every physician what you know

effects.log: Slower, and many die. But the cure is human, and stays when you are gone.
